status_note: Opened primary-source theorem interiors and compared scope. No proof reconstruction, proof audit, or novelty claim.

task.goal: Focused primary-source search for prior results that prove, subsume, or contradict the supplied centered quantum-chaos and entropy claim.

target_supplied_by_coordinator.state_class: Permutation-invariant N-qubit states with arbitrary density operators inside Schur-Weyl spin sectors.
target_supplied_by_coordinator.sector_tail: E exp(t M/sqrt(N)) <= A exp(B t^2 + C t), for every t >= 0 and fixed A,B,C, where M=2j.
target_supplied_by_coordinator.center: tau = rho_1, the actual one-qubit marginal.
target_supplied_by_coordinator.local_claim: Centered Petz chi-square and D(rho_r || tau^tensor r) are O((r/N)^2), uniformly for r=o(N); exact maximally-mixed sector weights are one example.
target_supplied_by_coordinator.operational_claim: Spin-variance violation supports an all-separable-sound entanglement certificate with fresh-preparation cost Theta(N^2/r^2), at most r accessed sites per preparation, 2 <= r=o(N); r=1 is impossible.

task.scope: Primary-source full-text second pass on relative-entropy equivalence of ensembles, constrained quantum de Finetti, representation-theoretic sector tails, quantum U-statistics, and spin-variance witnesses. No proof audit.

sources.title: Equivalence of Statistical Mechanical Ensembles for Non-Critical Quantum Systems
sources.scope_result: General small-global-relative-entropy plus finite-correlation reference implies averaged local trace-norm closeness under an explicit region-size condition.
sources.mismatch: Does not establish the global entropy premise from the supplied spin-sector tail; gives trace norm, not centered Petz chi-square/KL, and does not cover all sublinear block sizes.

sources.title: On the local equivalence between the canonical and the microcanonical ensembles for quantum spin systems
sources.scope_result: Finite-volume local equivalence for canonical and fine-tuned microcanonical states under short-range, translation-invariant Hamiltonian and clustering/thermodynamic assumptions.
sources.mismatch: Thermal/Hamiltonian constrained and expectation/trace-local; not arbitrary permutation-invariant spin-sector states or centered entropy expansions.

sources.title: De Finetti methods in Quantum Information
sources.scope_result: Constrained de Finetti operator domination when the entire marginal is fixed to an exact tensor power; separate global-entropy hypothesis yields mixture approximation.
sources.mismatch: The coordinator fixes only the one-site center and asks for divergence to its tensor power; theorem premise/output differ. Thesis source, not peer-reviewed article.

sources.title: Symmetry shapes thermodynamics of macroscopic quantum systems
technical_locations: sector entropy decomposition and rate functions, HTML lines 53-102
canonical equilibrium sector law and SU(2) model, lines 106-153
sources.scope_result: Symmetry/irrep dimensions and equilibrium sector distributions determine thermodynamic entropy and large-deviation rate functions.
sources.mismatch: Model-specific equilibrium laws; no uniform theorem over arbitrary PI states and no local centered Petz chi-square/KL bound.

sources.title: Uniqueness, Cramér-Rao Efficiency and Concentration Bounds for Quantum U-Statistics
technical_locations: marginal/function correspondence and variance results, lines 81-114
sources.scope_result: Permutation-invariant statistics over independent copies, including unbiasedness, variance, and concentration results.
sources.mismatch: Does not study correlated exchangeable N-body states or their local marginals.

sources.title: Quantum Macrostates, Equivalence of Ensembles and an H-Theorem
sources.scope_result: Global macrostate entropy, concentration, ensemble equivalence, and monotonicity under macroscopic dynamics.
sources.mismatch: No finite-N local marginal-to-product expansion under sector-tail control.

sources.title: Criteria to detect genuine multipartite entanglement using spin measurements
technical_locations: motivation and witness scope, PDF lines 96-105 and 145-159
sources.scope_result: Spin-variance criteria for multipartite entanglement with explicit witness/separability conditions.
sources.mismatch: Does not establish the coordinator's access-r fresh-preparation complexity, all-separable certificate scope, or r=1 impossibility.
